business: Siemens Energy AG (Munich; FWB: ENR) makes gas and steam turbines, grid equipment, wind turbines, compressors and electrolysers for utilities and industry; Omterra is its new group brand, not a separate spin-off.

funding.status: Public parent: Siemens Energy AG, Frankfurt (FWB: ENR), DAX constituent; Q3 FY2026 (Apr-Jun 2026) revenue EUR 11.4bn, orders EUR 17.9bn, backlog EUR 162bn (reported Aug 2026). The unit to be carved out, Transformation of Industry (steam turbines, compressors, electrolysers; oil & gas, chemicals, process, maritime customers), had EUR 5.7bn revenue, 11.3% margin and c. 17,000 employees in FY2025. On 25 Aug 2026 the supervisory board approved preparing its legal and operational separation; the group intends to deconsolidate it and keep a minority stake, with options from external investors to a capital-markets transaction. Goldman Sachs is advising; CVC, EQT, Bain Capital, Brookfield and KKR are reported as potential bidders. No transaction has been signed as of 8 Sep 2026.
funding.valuation: Transformation of Industry unit reported as potentially worth more than EUR 10bn (Bloomberg, cited Aug 2026); not a transacted value

business: Einride develops and operates digital, electric and autonomous heavy-duty freight for shippers, combining a planning platform, electric truck fleets, charging and driverless vehicles, from Stockholm with operations in the US and Europe.

funding.status: Public: Einride AB, Nasdaq (ADSs 'ENRD', warrants 'ENRDW'), trading since 10 Jun 2026 after the business combination with Legato Merger Corp. III closed on 9 Jun 2026 (shareholder approval 4 Jun 2026); pre-money equity value $1.35bn at closing (announced at $1.8bn in Nov 2025); oversubscribed $113m PIPE; c. $219m expected gross proceeds before redemptions, with 16,596,675 Legato shares redeemed. First-half 2026 results (18 Aug 2026): revenue SEK 273m (c. $27m), up 26% at constant currency; guidance for H2 2026 constant-currency revenue growth of 60-73%; Amazon deployment of 75 electric heavy-duty trucks and a post-period partnership to deploy 500 Tesla Semi trucks via third-party financing. Share price c. $4.45 and market capitalisation c. $623m in early Sep 2026 per market-data sites.

business: Slate Auto is a Troy, Michigan-based EV start-up building a stripped-down, customisable electric pickup (convertible to an SUV) priced from $24,950, manufactured at its plant in Warsaw, Indiana, for US retail buyers.

funding.status: Private. Pricing announced and paid preorders opened 24 Jun 2026 at $24,950 (truck) / $29,950 (SUV build), with more than 160,000 refundable reservations at the time of the Series C and over 180,000 reported by June 2026. First deliveries expected Q4 2026 from the Warsaw, Indiana plant; CEO told CNBC on 24 Jun 2026 the truck will be profitable and targets positive cash flow next year. No new financing found since April 2026.
